extracted.name: Easy Lentil Soup
extracted.description: This simple tomato lentil soup comes together in under 45 minutes with just six ingredients from your pantry.
instruction_lines: Bring chicken broth, lentils, onion, tomato paste, garlic, and cumin to a boil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Reduce the heat, cover, and simmer until lentils are soft, 30 to 45 minutes.
